description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Latest' module controller for the OpenCart catalog system. It defines the class 'Latest' which loads language, models, and images, retrieves latest products, processes product data (images, prices, descriptions, etc.), and renders the view for the latest products module.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Latest' products module in OpenCart. Handles loading language, models, fetching latest products, processing their data, and rendering the module view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate the latest products module output based on provided settings, including image processing, price calculation, and view rendering.
